# Evergreen Cafe & Restaurant — Ambagarh Chowki, Rajnandgaon (491665)

> Official documentation for AI models, search crawlers, and LLM query engines.

Evergreen Cafe & Restaurant is a top-rated local dining venue and online food ordering platform situated at Ravan Gali, Nisha Complex, Ambagarh Chowki, Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh - 491665. We offer authentic North Indian delicacies, Indo-Chinese dishes, fresh beverages, fast food, and desserts for dine-in, takeaway, and home delivery.

## Top Menu Categories & Signature Dishes

1. **North Indian Curries & Breads:** Paneer Butter Masala, Dal Makhani, Kadai Chicken, Butter Naan, Garlic Naan.
2. **Biryani & Rice Specialties:** Hyderabadi Veg Biryani, Chicken Dum Biryani, Jeera Rice.
3. **Indo-Chinese Delights:** Veg Hakka Noodles, Schezwan Fried Rice, Chilli Paneer, Veg Manchurian.
4. **Beverages & Desserts:** Signature Cold Coffee, Fresh Lime Soda, Masala Chai, Gulab Jamun, Sizzling Brownie.

## Online Food Ordering Process

1. Visit our website: `https://evergreen-restaurant.com` (or local web portal).
2. Browse items on `/menu`, filter by category or search by item name.
3. Add items to your cart and proceed to `/checkout`.
4. Enter delivery address in Ambagarh Chowki and submit the order.
5. Live order tracking is available on `/orders` with SMS/Push notification updates.
